methodology: Five-ayah first-pass screening; earlier texts are research leads, not public verified relationships. Reviewed preceding PR #275 and open RLS PR #93. Qur'an 7:158–160 and Sefaria Exodus 15:27 consulted; complete original-language collation pending. Do not infer dependence.

records.topic: Divine mercy, judgment, almsgiving and faith
records.notes: Mercy and punishment are broad theological motifs; Qur'an's extension of mercy to all things and subsequent specification of recipients must not be equated with the covenant formula in Exodus.
records.pending_question: Check Hebrew divine-attribute formula, Greek witnesses, and whether any distinctive verse-specific expression exists.

records.topic: The messenger described as written in Torah and Gospel; lawful and unlawful things
records.notes: This verse makes a claim about earlier scripture, not an independently established identification of Muhammad in any named passage. The listed passages are later interpretive candidates, with contested referents and distinct wording.
records.pending_question: Assess pre-Islamic textual readings, historical referents, Gospel dating and Muslim/Christian/Jewish interpretations separately; do not label any candidate verified prophecy.

records.topic: Universal summons to follow the unlettered prophet
records.notes: Universal religious proclamation is a broad motif; the passages do not name the Qur'anic prophet or establish direct literary relationship.
records.pending_question: Check whether any unusually specific pre-Islamic parallel exists beyond a generic universal mission motif.

records.topic: A just and truth-guided group among Moses' people
records.notes: Judgment and truth among Israel are shared ethical ideas but no identified narrative or distinctive phrase corresponds closely to this Qur'anic claim.
records.pending_question: Check original wording and Jewish interpretive traditions; absent a distinctive parallel classify no specific source established.

records.topic: Twelve Israelite tribes, twelve springs, cloud, manna and quail
records.notes: Exodus 15:27 mentions twelve springs at Elim, not twelve streams from Moses' struck rock. Exodus 17 recounts water from a rock but does not give twelve outlets. Exodus 16 contains manna/quail; Qur'an combines these motifs into one verse.
records.pending_question: Collate MT/LXX for rock, Elim springs, cloud and food, compare with Qur'an 2:60 and early Jewish traditions; assess whether the twelve-springs linkage predates Islam.
